findings.detail: Math.random().toString(36) used for session tokens. Adequate for testbed; production requires crypto.randomUUID() or JWT with proper signing.
MINI-001: openid length >= 3 enforced server-side. Production WeChat requires OAuth2 code→openid exchange validated against WeChat API.
findings.recommendation: Integrate WeChat OAuth2 code2session endpoint for production.

findings.detail: ADMINS Set gates admin routes. Production requires database-backed roles with audit trail for role changes.
findings.recommendation: Move admin roles to database with audit log.

findings.detail: MINI-004: /api/config returns appId only, never appSecret. Confirmed by artifact V2_7-ART-001 test 'config never exposes secret'.
CROSS_USER_ACCESS_DENIED enforced. NC1 negative control confirms cross-user order access blocked.
Duplicate transactionId correctly deduplicated. Confirmed by artifact V2_7-ART-001.

risk_notes: Session token generation uses Math.random() — adequate for testbed, must upgrade for production
Openid validation is token-level only — production requires WeChat API server-side validation
No rate limiting on auth endpoints — production requires brute-force protection
No CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints
non_claims: This review does NOT constitute a professional penetration test
This review does NOT verify production-grade cryptographic implementations
This review does NOT cover infrastructure/network security
Semgrep static analysis was not run (TOOL_UNAVAILABLE in this testbed)
